summary: Phase K — CMS Design tab + floating Music widget + S3/CloudFront fallback + mobile/tablet polish. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (CMS CRUD, admin gating, public music settings, MUSIC_ENABLED toggle, gridfs fallback for image upload, and regression on categories/products/currency/recommendations). Frontend: Admin Design page loads all 13 sections with proper testids; save propagates to storefront announcement bar via wth:content-saved CustomEvent; reset (with window.confirm accepted) deletes the DB override and reverts the storefront. Music widget mounts on all storefront pages, correctly hidden on /admin/*; MP3 URL seeded to the expected URL and returned by /api/settings/public. Mobile (390x844) and tablet (768x1024) layouts render cleanly — no overlap between the music widget and the hero CTA. One hydration warning (button-in-button in MusicWidget) surfaces on every page load and should be fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'music-widget-expand' <button> is rendered as a direct DOM child of the outer 'music-widget-toggle' <button>. Nesting a button inside another button is invalid HTML and produces a React hydration console error on every page load: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' It also makes the small expand icon's click behavior fragile because two overlapping click handlers race (outer toggle onClick calls a.play() which throws → catch → showPlayHint; inner onClick calls setCollapsed(false)). Recommended fix: change the inner expand element to a <span role="button" tabIndex=0 onKeyDown/onClick=...> (or a <div>), or move the expand affordance out of the outer button entirely (e.g. render two sibling buttons — a play pill and a small chevron).

rca_of_the_issue: Button-in-button in MusicWidget: the collapsed pill (music-widget-toggle) contains a smaller icon-button (music-widget-expand) as a DOM descendant. HTML5 spec disallows interactive descendants of <button> — Chromium's parser + React hydration both flag this. Behaviorally, in Playwright `page.click('[data-testid=music-widget-expand]', force=True)` centers the click on the 12x12 inner button but the outer <button>'s click handler still fires (because in most user-agents the browser DOM parser closes the outer button early and hoists the inner one out — but React under Next-style hydration re-nests them, producing an inconsistent event graph). Result: expand icon does not reliably open the expanded panel via a scripted click. Fix: replace the inner <button> with a <span role='button' tabIndex=0 onKeyDown={handler} onClick={handler}> — keeps a11y, drops the invalid nesting, and lets stopPropagation continue to work.
